name: Tan-oak
desc: Tan-oak (Notholithocarpus densiflorus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 268 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Notholithocarpus densiflorus, commonly known as the tanoak or tanbark-oak, is a broadleaf tree in the family Fagaceae, and the type species of the genus Notholithocarpus.
